notes.title: Multiplayer Playtest
notes.content:
Starting now and during the weekend there will be a Playtest for a new multiplayer mode so that I can look for bugs and any perfomance issues, there will be acess for the full game for free in order to also collect has much feedback as possible in order to improve the game further

There has been changes to the game that will be avaiable to play during the Playtest, those changes will only go live once there are no issues with the build.



Updates:

No longer need to restart the track level every time you wnat the restart the current run, there will be a transition screen followed by the restart
Multiplayer mode , you can now play with other players any of the 25 tracks , the lobby player is set to 20 by now, might change after further testing
GPU Perfomance has been improved between 30% to 60% depending on the track
Fixed a bug where when the ball was in mid air it would cause stutter occasionally
The ball movement has been changed , still trying to perfect it might feel off for players that have played the game already
Fireworks only fire once you have beaten your personal record , not everytime you cross the finish line
Added Portuguese localization, looking forward to add more languages over time
Some other minor things that I forgot


Thank you for evrybody that will get a chance to playtest the game , feedback will be appreciated
Have a great weekend
